research.title: Metrics That Matter: Are We Becoming Harder to Attack?
research.summary: Vulnerability counts, closed tickets, and remediation SLAs show what security teams have done. They cannot, by themselves, show whether the environment became harder to attack. This Horizon3 infographic reframes measurement around a more direct question: are.
